site.title: Mohil Kumar
site.description: Portfolio of Mohil Kumar, a software developer building fast, accessible web products with React, Astro and Supabase.
hero.title: I build web products that stay fast under load.
hero.body: Software developer at Wonkru Media in Gurugram, working across React, Astro, Node and Supabase. I care about the parts users feel: first paint, keyboard access, and pages that still work when the network does not.
about.title: About
about.body1: I am a software developer with close to two years of hands on experience. At Wonkru Media in Gurugram I build and maintain web applications with React, Astro and Tailwind CSS, and write REST APIs with Node, Express, MongoDB and Supabase.
about.body2: Before that I spent eight months as a frontend developer intern at Wendor Innovations, building the inventory section of their web app. Outside work I build projects to learn new tools: this site runs on Astro and Supabase, and my YouTube clone is built with React 19.
